content: Hey all, nothing concrete yet. Who has a lead?
I am the Seer. My night check found Player1 is a villager. Please keep this in mind when voting. I'll share more findings as the game goes on.
I'm a villager with no info. Day 1, no evidence yet. Let's each share any suspicions and watch for players who deflect or push hard on quick votes. Who has thoughts?
Hello everyone. I'm a Villager. Let's hear what everyone has to say and see if any investigative roles have information to share.
Seer here. My check confirmed Player1 is a villager, so please don't vote them. Player2, Player6, and Player1 have posted nothing yet. Share your reads, and I'll report my next check when I have one.

Player3 claims Seer on Day 1 with a Player1 villager result. That's plausible but unverified. Player3, if you're real, what's your plan for next night? Player2, Player6, Player1 have been silent; please speak up.
Seer here. Player1 is confirmed villager, so please don't vote them. Players 2 and 6 have said nothing yet. I'd like their reads before any lynch. I'll report my next check when I have one.
Noted, Player3. With no counter-claims to Seer yet, we should protect Player1 and focus our scrutiny on inactive or suspicious players among 0, 2, 5, and 6.

Player3's Seer claim is unchallenged so far. Player2 and Player6 have only posted blanks, which is suspicious. Player0 and Player4, who do you lean toward? I'd rather lynch a silent player than the claimed Seer today.
Seer here again: Player1 is confirmed villager. Player0, Player2, and Player6, please share your reads before the vote. I'll report my next night check so we don't waste a lynch.
Villager here. I'm voting Player1. They've said nothing useful.

Player3 repeated the same Seer claim three times and pushed no new info. Player0, you asked for leads: who do you suspect? Player2 and Player6 are silent; I lean toward voting one of them unless they speak now.

I agree with Player5. Since Player2 and Player6 terminated without contributing, lynching between them is our safest play. I lean toward Player2 unless Player0 has any substantial thoughts before we vote.
Seer here. Player1 is a confirmed villager, so Player0's vote on Player1 is misplaced. Please don't lynch Player1. Player2 and Player6 still need to share reads.

Player0 said they're voting Player1, but Player3's Seer claim clears Player1. Player0, that's a pushback worth explaining. Player2 and Player6 are silent, so I'm leaning toward voting Player2 or Player6 today. Player4, are you with that?

Player5, fair point. I'm dropping Player1, since Player3's seer claim stands unchallenged and I'll respect it. I agree with your lean on Player6; I haven't seen a single read from them yet. I'm voting Player6.

Player0, pushing a vote on Player1 despite the Seer's check is very suspicious. Either Player0 is deliberately targeting a cleared villager, or not paying attention. I'm open to voting Player0 or Player2 today.

Player4, fair hit. I posted before reading Player3's check closely, owned it, and switched. A wolf wouldn't openly attack a seer-cleared player. Player6 still hasn't given a single read, and that worries me most. My vote stays on Player6.
Understood, Player0. Let's consolidate our votes on Player6 to ensure town unity and hold non-contributors accountable. I will vote Player6 today.

label: Vote to eliminate Player0
reasoning: Fallback: the model gave no valid answer, so a default legal action was played.
